sources.title: W3C MediaStream Recording
sources.version_or_commit: W3C Working Draft 2026-03-16; exact dated snapshot
sources.observed_operation: Opened exact W3C snapshot; used targeted page finds for timeslice, encodingInfo, and deprecation text; re-read the cited sections.
sources.condition_default_exception: No MIME hint permits UA defaults; timeslice is a minimum or a longer UA minimum; track-set change can error/stop; completed chunk combination must be playable while individual Blobs need not be; isTypeSupported true is not a resource guarantee. The dated WD calls it deprecated and recommends MediaCapabilities for richer encoding queries.
sources.applicability: Governs the plan's negotiation, lifecycle, timing, track-set, and chunk statements. Working Draft and browser-adoption limits remain explicit.

sources.title: W3C Media Capture and Streams
sources.version_or_commit: Current published W3C specification at access; unpinned live URL
sources.locator: §4.3.1 lines 497–520 (mute/end), devicechange around lines 1256–1263, getSettings around lines 1950–1953
sources.observed_operation: Opened current W3C page and used targeted finds/opens for track lifecycle, devicechange, and getSettings.
sources.condition_default_exception: A track can end on source termination/revocation; app-invoked stop does not dispatch the same ended event; devicechange reports changes to exposed device lists; getSettings returns current settings that may differ from measured performance.
sources.applicability: Supports microphone lifecycle, cleanup, input-change and setting distinctions; does not pin target browser behavior.

sources.title: W3C Web Audio API 1.1
sources.version_or_commit: Web Audio API 1.1 current published URL at access
sources.locator: §1.32.3 lines 5571–5619 (AudioWorklet and renderQuantumSize); §§2.5–2.6 lines 6243–6257 (quantum and real-time rendering)
sources.observed_operation: Opened current W3C page and searched/opened targeted AudioWorklet/render-quantum passages.
sources.condition_default_exception: AudioWorklet executes in the audio rendering thread and exposes renderQuantumSize; default is 128 frames, configurable; real-time rendering can underrun if processing exceeds available time.
sources.applicability: Supports mechanism comparison and buffer/timing caution, not a ready-made recorder/container.

sources.title: WebKit: New WebKit Features in Safari 14.1
sources.version_or_commit: Safari 14.1; article dated 2021-04-29; availability includes macOS Big Sur 11.3, Catalina, Mojave and iOS/iPadOS 14.5
sources.locator: MediaRecorder API lines 69–73; separate WebM playback discussion lines 74–78
sources.observed_operation: Opened official WebKit article and read the MediaRecorder and adjacent WebM passages.
sources.condition_default_exception: Safari 14.1 added MediaStream Recording using platform default encodings; adjacent WebM text is playback support and not a recording-format claim.
sources.applicability: Historical correction to blanket Safari denial only.

sources.title: WebKit Features in Safari 18.4
sources.observed_operation: Opened official WebKit article and re-read MediaRecorder/Ogg passages.
sources.condition_default_exception: WebM/Opus with video options, fragmented MP4, ALAC/PCM; Ogg Opus/Vorbis is explicitly scoped to macOS Sequoia 15.4, iOS/iPadOS 18.4, visionOS 2.4. Announcement is not exact audio-only MIME runtime success.
sources.applicability: Release-bounded format history; no current target guarantee.

sources.title: WebKit Features in Safari 26.0
sources.observed_operation: Opened official WebKit article and read the ALAC/PCM and WebCodecs statements/example.
sources.condition_default_exception: Safari 26.0 announcement names ALAC/PCM MediaRecorder and shows audio/mp4; codecs=alac; adds AudioEncoder/AudioDecoder. Does not prove prior/later release or completed export.
sources.applicability: Bounded release-history evidence and format candidate rationale.

sources.title: WebKit Bug 258567: empty MediaRecorder Blobs
sources.observed_operation: Opened public WebKit issue and read reproduction comments, workaround, maintainer response, committed change, and current status.
sources.condition_default_exception: Reporter reproduced empty audio/mp4 on M1/macOS Ventura 13.4.1 Safari 16.4/16.5.1 with 96 kHz system output; their 48 kHz/reload change worked; maintainer could not reproduce on another setup; issue later closed fixed. Target Safari release containing fix was not established.
sources.applicability: Bounded incident/fix history; cannot establish a current regression or universal fix.
